tools.name: nanobanana_image_generation
tools.description: Generates content (text and/or images) based on a multimodal prompt using Gemini Image generation models.

prompt.description: The text prompt for content generation.

model.description:
Model for image generation. Can be a full model ID or a common name. Supported models:
- *gemini-2.5-flash-image* (Ratios: 1:1, 3:2, 2:3, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9) Aliases: *Nano Banana*, *nano-banana*
- *gemini-3-pro-image* (Ratios: 1:1, 3:2, 2:3, 3:4, 1:4, 4:1, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 1:8, 8:1, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9, 9:21) (Sizes: 1K, 2K, 4K) Aliases: *Nano Banana Pro*, *Gemini 3 Pro Image*
- *gemini-3.1-flash-image* (Ratios: 1:1, 3:2, 2:3, 3:4, 1:4, 4:1, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 1:8, 8:1, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9, 9:21) (Sizes: 512, 1K, 2K, 4K) Aliases: *Nano Banana 2*
- *gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image* (Ratios: 1:1, 1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9) (Sizes: 1K) Aliases: *Nano Banana 2 Lite*

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated images. Note: supported aspect ratios are model-dependent.

image_size.description: Optional. Size of the generated images: 1K, 2K, or 4K. Defaults to 1K when unset. Note: supported sizes are model-dependent.

images.description: Optional. A list of local file paths or GCS URIs for input media (images, videos, or PDFs).

gcs_bucket_uri.description: Optional. GCS URI prefix to store generated images (e.g., your-bucket/outputs/).

output_directory.description: Optional. Local directory to save generated image(s) to.

output_filename.description: Optional. Client-predictable base name for the generated file(s).

seed.description: Optional. Non-negative integer seed for best-effort reproducible image generation.
